serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: You: Huh? You: There seems to be commotion over there. Let’s check it out. It’s two homeless people fighting. I think I know one of them, but the crowd is too thick to know for sure. ???1: 50$ on the older one in the blue coat. ???2: No way, dude. Crackhead’s gonna crack his skull. Bet. Are they…{{wi}} betting on who’s gonna win? ???1: Oh! That was a nice punch! ???2: Damn it! It’s not fair! That crackhead has lost all his strength all of a sudden! I’m done with this walk. I want to go home… After seeing this, do I still want to stay here?
